import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    allowed_species = ["Adelie", "Chinstrap", "Gentoo"]
    df["species"] = df["species"].str.strip()
    df["species"] = df["species"].apply(lambda x: x if x in allowed_species else pd.NA)

    df["island"] = df["island"].str.strip().str.title()

    df["body_mass_g"] = df["body_mass_g"].str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
    body_mass = df["body_mass_g"].astype(float)
    df = df[(body_mass >= 2500) & (body_mass <= 6500)]
    return df

def answer(df):
    grouped = df.groupby("species")["body_mass_g"].mean()
    return {species: mean for species, mean in grouped.items() if pd.notna(mean)}
